game.title: Alan Wake
game.blurb: Story-driven action thriller and shooter from Remedy Entertainment, published by Microsoft Studios (RAWG also lists THQ Nordic and Remedy Entertainment), released 2010-05-14. RAWG average playtime: 5 hours. Genres: Action, Shooter, Adventure. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes, with episode names from the Fandom page list.

chapters.title: Episodes 1 to 3
chapters.summary: The first half of the story: Nightmare, Taken and Ransom (episode names from Fandom page titles). Story achievements placed here by Steam order.

chapters.title: Episodes 4 to 6
chapters.summary: The second half: The Truth, The Clicker and Departure (episode names from Fandom page titles). Story achievements placed here by Steam order. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Normal, Hard and Nightmare
chapters.summary: Finishing the game on Normal, Hard and Nightmare difficulty.

chapters.title: Manuscripts, Thermoses and Bright Falls
chapters.summary: Manuscript pages, hidden chests, coffee thermoses, radio shows, TV shows, can pyramids and local history and culture.

chapters.title: Combat and Challenge Runs
chapters.summary: Defeating Taken with each weapon, flares, flashbangs and dodges, batteries, generators, driving, and the timed or no-shot runs in named story sections.

chapters.title: Special 1
chapters.summary: The first special episode: finding help, following the signal, the furnaces, alarm clocks, cardboard standees and speed and no-reload runs. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Special 2
chapters.summary: The second special episode: the elevator ride, the lighthouse approach, the tornado, Night Springs video games, the secret area and the final obstacle. Spoiler-guarded.

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). RAWG's first result is the expected entry (id 19487). Steam app 108710 ("Alan Wake") from the store list; its schema is named "ValveTestApp108710" (a placeholder name). None of the 67 Steam achievements is hidden. Sixteen story achievements come first in the Steam list; the first eight were put in Episodes 1 to 3 and the next eight in Episodes 4 to 6, which is our own guess from that order, not checked. The episode names come from alanwake.fandom.com page titles ("Episode 1: Nightmare (Alan Wake)" to "Episode 6: Departure (Alan Wake)"); the Steam achievement "Departure" (finish on Normal) shares the last name. Fandom also has pages "Special 1: The Signal (Alan Wake)" and "Special 2: The Writer (Alan Wake)", and RAWG has separate entries "Alan Wake: The Signal" and "Alan Wake: The Writer"; the Steam achievements say only "Special 1" and "Special 2", so the chapters use those words. "Mirror Peak", "Night Life in Bright Falls" and "On the Road to Cauldron Lake" are story sections named in challenge achievements, which sit in the combat chapter because the data does not say which episode holds them. StrategyWiki has "Alan Wake" as a stub (completion stage 0, Category:Stubs) with no subpages written. alanwake.fandom.com answers the API under "Alan Wake" with about 225 linked articles; names only were looked at, nothing copied.
